reviews.comment: I never use rate my professor, but she's just so sweet, I had too! If you need an English class, TAKE HER! She is so nice, understanding, and hilarious! You can tell she really cares about the subject and her students! I have taken about four English classes in college, and she's the best prof I've had by far! Take her class! You won't regret it!

*for ENG219*
Dr. Ives is cares about what she teaches, and wants you to care about it too. She is easy to reach outside of class and provides great feedback on assignments; also grades leniently and understands that opinion is subjective to each individual. Bonus: she makes references to relevant memes often. Take her class!

Dr. Ives is AMAZING! She gives good lectures and lots of things to be graded on. She gave lots of notice on our individual project (essay), which had clear instructions. Exams were a toss-up; the first was relatively easy, while the second was pretty difficult. Lots of extra credit! Dr. Ives is so helpful and kind. Do yourself a favor and take her!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr Ives is a really amazing professor. She is so caring and always makes time to meet with you and emails back quickly. It is a really fun subject and you can tell she is passionate. Lots of reading and she expects participation in class but it is usually fun. Would 100% take her again. She gives extra credit and essay revisions throughout semester
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: She is such a nice and caring prof and is willing to work with you! I thought the Christmas Culture class would be interesting and fun but honestly is was a TON of reading every night that was really boring. The essay instructions are somewhat unclear as they are meant to be "fun" essays. Lots of extra credit at the end which helped.

Very kind and understanding professor. Really works with you and wants you to succeed. Strict attendance policy, and lots of assigned articles and passages. Need to read assigned coursework to pass. Extra credit opportunities provided. Fun and interactive professor who tries to make lectures interesting.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters
